tasks.short: Calculate solar array production for a site.

steps.what: Enter climate, shading and roof orientation for the array.
Calculate potential solar array production for the site.
Apply the tariff and the feed-in rule to that yield.
Judge whether shading makes the production model unfit.
Record the production figure the representative will use.

tasks.design: A calculator turns orientation, tilt, shading and climate into annual production, then applies the tariff and the feed-in rule. The representative decides whether shading makes that figure unfit, and only a figure they accept is stored. Native calculation settings are tested before custom code.
tasks.previous_blocker: Yield was a sheet with climate numbers typed by hand, and the tariff was a second sheet.
tasks.enabler_now: The yield formula and the tariff are rules. Whether this roof's shade breaks the formula is not.
tasks.still_hard: Trees, dormers, and a horizon the measurements did not capture.
tasks.human_edge: The representative has stood on the roof and knows when the model is flattering it.

ambition.what: The representative decides, before a quote, whether the yield figure is fit to show the customer.

tasks.altitude: Shade judgements stay on the week. The representative can refuse to carry a yield figure forward.

reach.task: Decide whether a valuation model fits a particular property
reach.learn: How they set aside a model that ignores something they saw

evidence.claim: A calculator fed by site data and tariffs can produce a yield. Whether the site makes that figure unfit stays a judgement.
Net metering ends on 1 January 2027, and until 2030 the feed-in fee must be at least half of the bare supply tariff.

assumptions: Focal role is the solar sales representative. Boundary: from site measurements to a yield figure the representative will stand behind. Measuring the roof is a different task.

Structured fields are orientation, tilt, shading factor, climate zone and tariff code. The site visit produces the measurements. The tariff table produces the rates. Fallback: missing shade is not defaulted to zero.
Test the existing yield settings before custom code. No model writes the yield narrative.
Upkeep of 4 hours per 100 baseline hours covers climate zones and the feed-in rate.
unknowns: Which yield method the business is willing to stand behind.
Whether shading is a measured factor or a note.
research_questions: What share of roofs is too shaded for the standard calculator?

already_counted.description: Judge whether the model is fit

incremental.description: Update climate zones and feed-in rates

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: shading notes are too poor, so the representative recomputes by hand and will not store the model figure. High: inputs are complete and only the fitness judgement remains. That judgement is not removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Generate solar leads and develop new accounts.

steps.what: Pull solar customer leads and the opt-in flag.
Drop consumers who have not opted in to a call.
Generate the week's call list from solar energy leads.
Call company accounts and state name, company and purpose.
Call opted-in consumers to develop solar accounts.
Log the outcome on the account.

tasks.design: The {CRM} shows who may be called. Consumers, sole traders and ordinary partnerships without an opt-in are removed. The representative chooses the week's list and makes the calls, stating name, company and purpose, and announcing any recording. No dialler calls consumers. Native views are tested before custom code. Call analytics that observe the representative are not turned on.
tasks.previous_blocker: Lists were exported and called without a reliable opt-in mark, and outcomes were typed afterwards.
tasks.enabler_now: An opt-in flag can stop a consumer call. The call itself, and which account is worth it, stay with the representative.
tasks.still_hard: Stale opt-in records, and company numbers that are actually a household.
tasks.human_edge: The representative hears who is a prospect and who wants the call to end.

ambition.what: Households who have opted in can be called under the current rule, instead of the desk avoiding consumer calls entirely because the list could not show consent.

tasks.altitude: Call time stays on the week. The representative can refuse a list that still contains a consumer without opt-in.

reach.task: Call prospects who are allowed to be called
reach.learn: How they record consent before a consumer conversation

evidence.claim: A customer system can list leads and a consent flag. It can also send outreach. This design does not send consumer outreach on its own.

Since 1 July 2026, calls to consumers, sole traders and ordinary partnerships need prior opt-in, and existing customers are included. Home solar selling falls under that rule. Calls to private and public limited companies may proceed if the caller states name, company and purpose and announces any recording.
Works-council consent is required before customer-system tracking or call analytics that observe sellers.

assumptions: Focal role is the solar sales representative. Boundary: from a lead list to logged call outcomes. Home surveys are a different task.
Structured fields are account type, opt-in flag, phone and last outcome. The customer or a prior form produces the opt-in. Fallback: a missing opt-in means no consumer call.
Test native {CRM} views and fields before custom code. Do not enable call analytics.
Upkeep of 3 hours per 100 baseline hours covers the opt-in field and account-type rules.
unknowns: Whether opt-in is stored per person or only per account.
What share of leads is a household rather than a company.
research_questions: How often is the opt-in flag missing or stale?

approvals.approved_version: call list the representative accepted for company accounts
call list the representative accepted for opted-in consumers

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: opt-in data is missing, so consumer calls do not happen and company calls stay fully manual. High: the list is clean and only the calls and a short log remain. The calls are not removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Explain solar equipment and services to customers or dealers.

steps.what: Hear the technical question from the customer or dealer.
Find the equipment page that covers the question.
Explain solar power, systems and equipment to customers or dealers.
Write a follow-up from that page and send it if asked.

loop.input: The manual page and what was just explained
loop.output: A short note that adds no claim the page does not make
loop.check: Representative checks the note against the page before send
loop.stop: One draft; a claim that is not on the page is deleted
loop.why_not_simpler: The question was spoken, so the note is not a stored answer

tasks.design: The representative hears the question and explains it from the equipment page. A follow-up note, if asked, may say only what that page says, and the representative checks it before it is sent. Native manual search is tested before custom code. Questions the page does not cover stay in the conversation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manuals were PDFs, and follow-up mail was typed from memory of the meeting.
tasks.enabler_now: A manual page can anchor the note. Explaining a system to this person cannot be skipped.
tasks.still_hard: Questions about a fault on a roof the manual does not describe.
tasks.human_edge: The representative sees which part the customer did not understand.
tasks.altitude: Explanations stay on the week. The representative can refuse to send a note that goes beyond the page.

reach.role: Securities, Commodities, and Financial Services Sales Agents
reach.task: Explain a product from the official description
reach.learn: How they stop a written answer at the text they are allowed to use

evidence.claim: A manual can answer a question it covers. Anything outside it stays with a person, and a written claim can bind the seller.

assumptions: Focal role is the solar sales representative. Boundary: from a technical question to a spoken answer and, if asked, a checked note. Design of the system is out of scope.
Structured fields are product code and manual section. The manufacturer produces the page. Fallback: if no page matches, nothing is sent and the representative says so.
Test native document search before custom code.
Upkeep of 2 hours per 100 baseline hours covers manual versions.
unknowns: Whether manuals are stored per product code.
What share of questions is a repeat from the manual.
research_questions: How often is the honest answer absent from the manual?

incremental.description: Replace manual versions when a product changes

approvals.approved_version: follow-up note checked against the manual page

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the question is not in the manual, so the meeting is unchanged and no note is sent. High: the page is found quickly and only the explanation remains, with a short checked note. The explanation is not removed.

tasks.short: Assess a site's suitability for solar equipment.

steps.what: Assess sites for solar equipment with tape and compass.
Measure roof orientation, pitch and shade obstructions.
Enter the measurements in the site software.
Decide the site's suitability for the solar equipment.

tasks.design: The representative still visits, measures with a tape and a compass, and looks at shade. Measurements are entered in the {CRM} so a later yield step can use them. The suitability decision stays on the roof. Native site fields are tested before custom code.
tasks.previous_blocker: Measurements lived on paper and were typed, or lost, after the visit.
tasks.enabler_now: A site record can hold numbers. It cannot see the roof.
tasks.still_hard: Access the customer will not grant, and shade that changes with a tree the photo missed.
tasks.human_edge: The representative is standing there and can refuse a roof that looks fine in a photo.
tasks.altitude: Visits stay the week. The representative can mark a site unsuitable even when the numbers are complete.

reach.task: Walk a property before advising on it
reach.learn: Which defects they will not leave off the note

evidence.claim: Site assessment with a tape, a compass and a look at shade stays with the person who is there. Software only stores the measurements.

assumptions: Focal role is the solar sales representative. Boundary: from arrival on site to a suitability decision and stored measurements. The yield calculation is a different task.

Structured fields are orientation, pitch, usable area and shading notes. The representative produces them on site. Fallback: a measurement that was not taken is left blank, not estimated in the office.
Test native {CRM} site fields before custom code. There is no remote substitute for the visit in this task.
Upkeep of 2 hours per 100 baseline hours covers the measurement fields.
unknowns: Whether visits are by the representative or by a survey partner.
Which measurements the yield step actually requires.
research_questions: What share of visits finds the site unsuitable?

incremental.description: Keep the measurement fields aligned with the yield step

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every site is different and the entry is a small share, so almost nothing is saved. High: only the typing of measurements shrinks. The visit and the suitability decision stay.

role.altitude: The week is still site visits, demonstrations and customer conversations. Quotes and yield figures are calculated before the meeting. The representative can refuse to send a price or a saving the tariff rule did not produce.
